title: New Local User Account Created
description: Detects creation of new local user accounts on Linux servers, which may indicate persistence established by an attacker.
author: SOC Team
aql: SELECT QIDNAME(qid) as EventName, sourceIP, destinationIP, username, LOGSOURCENAME(logsourceid) as LogSource, payload, starttime FROM events WHERE LOGSOURCENAME(logsourceid) ILIKE '%LinuxServer%' AND (payload ILIKE '%useradd%' OR payload ILIKE '%adduser%' OR payload ILIKE '%new user:%' OR payload ILIKE '%user added%') ORDER BY starttime DESC LAST 300 SECONDS
